method: Same target annotation and same assay document. Whole descriptions identical after replacing exactly one selected span and normalizing whitespace/case. Numeric units normalized for values. Candidate generation uses descriptions only, independent of potency. Each observed comparison holds chemical identity fixed. Presence/absence spans retain the named reagent and all surrounding text. Construct changes hold target annotation, not protein sequence, fixed. Cell-line mentions may be expression hosts, not assay cell types. Missing unreported protocol differences remain uncontrolled. Long multi-protocol descriptions >4000 chars excluded. No causal or out-of-sample predictive claims.
